profile.headline: Software Engineer | Full-Stack Development | Java & Quarkus Expert | React & Angular Specialist | Microservices Architect | Kafka Enthusiast | CI/CD & Cloud Solutions

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Work on Spring JDBC Template, Named Parameter JDBC Template, Simple JDBC Template, and Simple JDBC Call.
•	Utilize Core Java to implement concepts like multithreading, concurrency, exception handling, file handling, I/O, generics, & Java collections.
•	Develop business logic with Java Core, Collections, Java 8 lambda expressions, streams, and LocalDate objects.
•	Create data layers using Hibernate framework, configure XML mapping files, write POJO classes, and develop PL/SQL stored procedures.
•	Design and implement DAO CRUD methods using Hibernate. Develop microservices using Quarkus to create, update, delete, and retrieve backend information.
•	Design and develop enterprise services using RAML and REST-based APIs, leveraging Mule ESB for transformations and custom implementations.
•	Build APIs and integrations for authentication and session management using OAuth 2.0, JWT, & Quarkus Security.
•	Work with Docker and Kubernetes to containerize and deploy Quarkus applications.
•	Implement Jersey REST APIs to facilitate communication between modules like UI & reporting.
•	Create a webkit abstracting cross-cutting concerns like authentication, authorization, error handling, and session monitoring using Quarkus Security.
•	Work with NoSQL databases to create custom applications and develop procedures for data conversion from Oracle to MongoDB.
•	Use Redis for caching and improving application performance. Optimize performance and build queries using Oracle10g.
•	Use Kafka for real-time stream processing and event-driven architectures.
•	Automate workflows and API testing using tools like Postman and SoapUI.
•	Design and implement CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and integrate with Git repositories.
•	Use Maven for project builds and implement unit testing with JUnit and Mockito.
•	Collaborate on Atlassian tools like Confluence for documentation, Bitbucket for code repository, and JIRA for task management.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Using Rally for bug tracking and project management.
•	Designed CSS-based page layouts that are cross-browser compatible and standards-compliant. Wrote page-level code using JavaScript with Angular 2 framework along with jQuery and other JavaScript libraries.
•	Working using Agile Software Development methodologies like Scrum, Sprint, and Traditional software models like Waterfall and TDD.
•	Used Rally for bug tracking and pull requests, Confluence where collaborate and shares important info and management, and GIT control source control also Used GitHub to store and maintain source code. 
•	Migrated the code from Angular 9 to Angular 11 to make the compilation faster, build optimization, to make the application support for multiple export alias. 
•	Responsible for developing UI pages using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, JSON, Angular, Ajax. Used Angular and Bootstrap as the front-end framework, with Typescript, CSS, and HTML.
•	Focused on debugging, fixing maintenance issues for applications using tools like JavaScript, HTML, CSS. 
•	Redesigned and maintain existing internal web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, AngularJS. 
•	Building front-end application and reusable UI components with AngularJS, Bootstrap, Angular Material. 
•	Used Angular Routing to navigate between different components. Involved Angular Route Guard for the Authentication and Authorization bypassing logged users’ JSON Web Token (JWT) into Browser local Storage.
•	Working with Jenkins under the CI/CD pipelines providing continuous improvement to agile software development teams.
•	Designed and implemented the REST API for the UI screen through the mobile user can look up the available health plans and monthly premium against each of them by taking the zip code as the parameter.

positions.title: Sr. Full Stack Java Developer
positions.description:
• Involved in the development of the UI using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, React and worked on JavaScript framework to augment browser - based applications with MVC capability.
• Worked in using React components, Forms, Events, Keys, Router, Animations and Flux concept.
• Developed various screens for the front end using React and used various predefined components from NPM (Node Package Manager) and Redux library.
• Worked with the rendering, re-rendering view React components, forms, events, and Redux asynchronous functions, client-side routing with React Router and React - Flux pattern for core dependency.
• Worked on writing minimal code in building re-usable forms with their validations using React with Redux Architecture.
• Analyzed the React server structure in legacy project, then mimicked the REST service by using Java JAX-WS API and did the corresponding configurations.
• Used React-Draggable for developing drag and drop functionality, components library, including Tree, Slide-View, and Table Grid along with bootstrap for dynamic responsive design.
• Designed and implemented the REST API for the UI screen through the mobile user can look-up the available health plans and monthly premium against each of them by taking the zip code as the parameter.
• Used Micro service architecture with Spring Boot based services interacting through a combination of REST and Apache Kafka message brokers also worked with Kafka Cluster using ZooKeeper.
• Developed end to end data processing pipelines that begin with receiving data using distributed messaging systems Kafka through persistence of data into HBase.

Environment: HTML, CSS, AJAX, Bootstrap, JavaScript, React, Redux, NodeJS, Java, Java8, Spring, Spring Boot, Spring AOP/IOC, Spring MVC architecture, JDBC, Hibernate, WebSphere, XML, NoSQL, GIT, Web Services, SOAP, RESTful JAX-RS, JSON, Jasmine, Karma, Junit, Mockito, Swagger, MongoDB, Kafka, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, JIRA, Agile

positions.title: Full Stack Java Developer
positions.description:
•Developed SPA by using Angular related technologies such as TypeScript, Angular Components, Directives, Pipes, Services, HTTP Client, Observables/Promise, Reactive/Template driven forms, Two - way data binding, Life Cycle Methods, Routing, and Routing Guards within multiple components.
•Used Angular Routing to navigate between different components. Involved Angular Route Guard for the Authentication and Authorization by passing logged users’ Json Web Token (JWT) into Browser localStorage.
•Implemented Angular concepts like Angular-animate, Angular-cookies, Angular-Filter, Angular-Mocks, Angular-sanitize.
•Designed and implemented an application using Spring MVC, Spring IOC, Dependency Injection Spring Annotations, Spring AOP, Spring Container-managed transactions, Hibernate.
•Used Spring Security for authentication and authorization and used OAuth2 for implementation of security.
•Used Java Messaging Service JMS for messaging, configured queues and topics on the WebLogic 10.3 Application Server and used them for messaging.
•Developed API’s to read and publish data from Elasticsearch cluster using native Java Transport client as well as REST client. Worked on Spring Integration with the Elasticsearch.
•Used Microservice architecture with Spring Boot based services interacting through a combination of REST and Apache Kafka message brokers and worked with Kafka Cluster using Zookeeper.
•Developed applications using Hibernate persistent framework, developed persistent classes, hibernate-mapping files, configured XML files, hibernate query language.

Environment: HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, jQuery, AJAX, JavaScript, Angular, NodeJS, Java, Java8, Spring, Spring Boot, Spring AOP/IOC, Spring MVC architecture, JDBC, Hibernate, WebSphere, XML, NoSQL, Bitbucket, Web Services, SOAP, Log4J, RESTful JAX-RS, JSON, Jasmine, Karma, Junit, Mockito, Swagger, Kafka, Splunk, Spark, MongoDB, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, JIRA, Agile

positions.title: Full Stack Java Developer
positions.description:
•	Involved in developing application using PostgreSQL and wrote SQL and PL/SQL queries to test the data that was sent through the external REST API calls.
•	Used Microservice architecture with Spring Boot based services interacting through a combination of REST and Apache Kafka message brokers.
•	Used Spring Kafka API calls to process the messages smoothly on Kafka Cluster setup.
•	Utilized RabbitMQ for asynchronous computation and gained better response speed.
•	Responsible for designing and deploying best SCM processes and procedures with Subversion (SVN), Bitbucket, GitHub, Git & eclipse. 
•	Implemented Java EE components using Spring MVC, Spring IOC, Spring transactions and Spring security modules.
•	Integrated Spring DAO for data access using Hibernate, used HQL and SQL for querying databases.
•	Worked Kubernetes for Microsoft Architecture to build CI/CD pipeline.
•	Worked with Jenkins under the CI/CD pipelines providing continuous improvement to agile software development teams.
•	Created clusters in Azure cloud and manage the cluster using Kubernetes. Using Jenkins to deploy code to Azure cloud, creating docker images and pushing them to container registry of Azure.
•	Worked on writing custom bundle and configure Prefix Machine to receive images from the simulator and then upload them to Microsoft cloud services such as Azure IoT Hub, Azure Evert Hub. Azure Blob Storage and eventually to Predix Timeseries service.
•	Created clusters in Azure cloud and manage the cluster using Kubernetes. Using Jenkins to deploy code to Azure cloud, creating docker images and pushing them to container registry of Azure.

Environment: HTML, CSS, AJAX, jQuery, JavaScript, React, NodeJS, Java, Java8, Spring, Spring Boot, Spring AOP/IOC, Spring MVC architecture, JDBC, Hibernate, WebSphere, XML, NoSQL, Oracle, SQL, GIT, Web Services, SOAP, Log4J, RESTful JAX-RS, JSON, Jasmine, Karma, Junit, Mockito, Swagger, MongoDB, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure
